description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question types within the R2I-Bench dataset, representing the proportions of different categories of reasoning challenges. The chart contains seven slices, each corresponding to a distinct question type. These are, in clockwise order starting from the top: Disjunctive & Conjunctive (50.49%, blue), Conjunctive (50.49%, purple), Approximate Quantities (45.03%, light blue), Comparative Relationships (36.26%, teal), Universal Quantifiers (29.07%, pink), Negation (27.91%, orange), Limiter (27.91%, red), and Existential Quantifiers (15.12%, green), and Absolute Absence (18.71%, light orange). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. A legend is present, listing each question type alongside its corresponding color. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size, though this is a visual observation and not explicitly indicated.
